current_en: Give your agent a StandTerm prompt
zh-TW: 讓 Agent 連線至 StandTerm
context: Getting-started dialog heading; descriptive text alone grants no access.
constraints: Keep permission requirements in the accompanying instructions. Do not expand public Agent Info. Desktop and Core may use different languages; keep the English Core control names recognizable alongside Chinese labels.

current_en: Select the tab where your agent runs. Use Agent Panel to enable access and choose permissions on each tab it may operate.
en: Select the tab where your agent runs. In Agent Panel, enable access and choose permissions for each tab it may operate.
zh-TW: 選取 Agent 所在的分頁。在 Agent 面板（Agent Panel）中，逐一為 Agent 可操作的分頁啟用存取並選擇權限。
context: First paragraph of Agent help; caller tab and permitted target tabs can differ.
constraints: Keep per-tab authorization, local/SSH distinction and current permission defaults. No implicit cross-tab grants. Desktop and Core may use different languages; keep the English Core control names recognizable alongside Chinese labels.

current_en: Open Agent connection, choose Copy Prompt, and paste it into your agent with the intended task. Follow the environment shown in that dialog.
en: Open Agent connection, choose Copy Prompt, and paste it into your agent with the task. Follow the environment shown in the dialog.
zh-TW: 開啟「Agent 連線」（Agent connection），選擇「複製連線指引」（Copy Prompt），再將指引連同任務貼給 Agent。請依對話框顯示的環境操作。
context: Connection-instructions paragraph; SSH/local setup remains in the preceding paragraph.
constraints: Match the actual Core control names, including Copy Prompt; retain environment/target guidance. Do not translate or modify the copied prompt payload here. Desktop and Core may use different languages; keep the English Core control names recognizable alongside Chinese labels.

current_en: Future captures save here automatically. Change this in StandTerm > Capture Settings.
en: Future files of this capture type save here automatically. Change the folder in Capture Settings.
context: Folder chooser message. PNG and WebM have separate saved folder preferences; this is a retained per-type choice, not a one-off Save As path. The first folder selection also seeds the other format if unset; later choices update only the selected format.
constraints: Keep extension values png/webm and chosen filesystem path literal. Cancel still returns null; do not change folder persistence or auto-save behavior. Preserve first-choice seeding; do not describe the two preferences as fully independent.

context: Capture Settings detail. Resolve the two current unset-folder labels separately in the later full catalog pass; this row preserves raw folder paths.
constraints: Keep response indices 0 Done, 1 screenshot-folder chooser, 2 recording-folder chooser, 3 open screenshot folder, 4 open recording folder. defaultId=0 and cancelId=0. No action inference from labels.

current_en: The terminal view could not be captured. Bring StandTerm to the foreground and retry. Window state is available in Diagnostics.
en: Could not capture the terminal view. Bring StandTerm to the foreground and try again. Check Diagnostics if it still fails.
context: Screenshot capturePage or empty-image failure before file output begins; retained diagnostic includes window state.
constraints: Preserve original Error cause and diagnostic fields. No automatic retry, focus manipulation, or capture-scope expansion.

context: Suffix added only if failed screenshot output has a partial path; it is not a successful PNG save notice.
constraints: Keep the raw path and preceding error. Do not delete or overwrite partial files, promise readability, or automatically retry. Preserve conditional display only when output.partial exists.

context: Recording failure suffix after recorder teardown and output close; partial WebM may be incomplete.
constraints: Keep raw error and path; do not promise playable or recoverable video, delete partial output, publish it as complete, or retry automatically.

current_en: Stop and save the recording before {action}?
en: Stop recording and attempt to save it before {action}?
context: Recording guard for another Desktop action. Current confirmStop awaits stop but returns true even if stop returns an error result; wording cannot guarantee a successful save.
constraints: Keep numeric response 1 as stop-and-continue; response 0/defaultId=0/cancelId=0 keeps recording and cancels the pending action. Keep capture-start/capture-stop/capture-status IDs and state unchanged. No new retry or save-success gate in this copy-only stage. Policy checkpoint before integration: decide whether save failure should block close/quit; use separate whole-message keys for close and quit if grammar requires it.

current_en: Keep this window open or minimize it to continue. Canceling stops the owned installation processes; prepared files are retained so you can retry on the next launch.
en: Keep this window open or minimize it to continue. Canceling stops this setup’s installation processes and keeps prepared files. Relaunch StandTerm to try again.
context: Close confirmation during preparation. Cancellation targets owned setup processes and waits for cleanup; prepared files remain.
constraints: Keep button index 0 Keep preparing and 1 Cancel setup; defaultId=0/cancelId=0. Preserve stale-window check and cooperative cancellation. Do not imply all Python processes are stopped or retry is automatic.

current_en: and downloads and installs Python dependencies from your configured package index. Dependencies can execute installation code. Internet access and disk space are required.
en: Python dependencies are downloaded from your configured package index and installed in the private environment. Installation can run code and requires internet access and disk space.
context: Exact dependency-effects fragment in preparePackagedBackend confirmation detail; preceding Core-copy/path/Python requirements and following retention policy remain separate.
constraints: Keep existing environment/backend selection and raw destination path. Confirm response 1 creates the environment; 0/defaultId/cancelId cancel. Do not imply bundled or verified dependencies, system Python installation, or privilege elevation.

current_en: Failed setup is retained for retry. Uninstall keeps environments by default; optional cleanup moves only verified idle venvs to a recovery folder. Core and user data are retained.
en: Failed setup files are kept for retry. Uninstall keeps environments by default. Optional cleanup moves verified idle venvs to recovery and keeps Core files and user data.
context: Exact retention fragment of the initial setup confirmation. The cleanup operation is a recoverable move rather than disk-space reclamation.
constraints: Keep venv-only cleanup boundary and verified/idle checks. Do not imply uninstall deletes Core or user data, that partial setup is ready, or that retry occurs without a user action.

current_en: {paths}\n\nNo disk space is freed. Core and settings are retained. Any environment that becomes busy or fails verification will be retained. Cancel keeps all listed venvs.
en: {paths}\n\nThis move does not free disk space. Core and settings stay in place. Busy or unverified environments are kept. Cancel keeps every listed venv.
context: Cleanup confirmation detail after candidate inventory, before detach-idle-venvs. Candidate paths are shown as a raw list.
constraints: Keep candidate IDs and source paths literal. Button index 0 keeps environments; index 1 moves listed candidates. defaultId=0/cancelId=0. Recheck eligibility; no deletion or permission expansion.

current_en: Cleanup did not report completion. Check venv-recovery before retrying.
en: Cleanup completion was not confirmed. Check venv-recovery before retrying.
context: execute help when detach-idle-venvs does not provide confirmed completion; moves may have partially occurred.
constraints: Keep recovery-directory name venv-recovery literal. Do not claim no files moved, roll back, delete, or automatically retry.

current_en: Setup timed out. Check internet access and retry.
en: Setup timed out. Check internet access and the setup log before retrying.
context: Fixed ERRORS.setup_timeout message. Timeout does not guarantee prepared files were removed or no installation work occurred.
constraints: Keep setup_timeout error key, timeout values, cancellation and retained files unchanged. No automatic retry or promise of a clean environment.

current_en: This restarts StandTerm and closes terminal sessions. Python dependencies may be downloaded and installed.
en: StandTerm will restart and close terminal sessions. Python dependencies may be downloaded and installed.
context: Common consequence fragment for source enable/update/prepare/recover confirmations.
constraints: Keep action IDs enable/update/prepare/recover and source values bundled/git. Button index 1 restarts; 0/defaultId/cancelId cancel. Do not treat translated labels as action IDs.

current_en: Core files and data in the previous environment are retained. Recovery does not roll back user data.
en: The previous environment’s Core files and data are kept. Restoring bundled Core does not roll back user data.
context: Conditional recover confirmation detail; restores the installed Core source rather than reverting user data.
constraints: Only for typed action recover. Preserve previous environment and pending-action consumption. No destructive cleanup or rollback feature.

current_en: Git uses the official askac/standterm repository, main branch. Its files are not checked against the installed bundle hashes. Local changes are allowed, but updates refuse to overwrite them. The Desktop shell stays installed.
en: Git Core uses askac/standterm on the main branch. Its files are not verified against the installed bundle hashes. Updates refuse to overwrite local changes. The Desktop shell stays installed.
context: Git-source confirmation detail; removes marketing qualifier while keeping source provenance and integrity boundary.
constraints: Keep askac/standterm and main literal. Preserve refusal on local changes and no reset/stash behavior. No automatic update, retry, or implied equivalence to the verified installed bundle.

current_en: Authorization and recovery data are local to each Core source; switching may require reauthorization.
en: Each Core source has separate authorization and recovery data. Switching may require reauthorization.
context: Common source-change confirmation suffix; switching may change which credentials or recovery registrations are available.
constraints: Do not promise migration, reuse, deletion, or automatic authorization. Preserve sourceStore identity/source/pending fields and backend credential boundaries.

current_en: The Desktop shell can retry or restore its installed Core. Existing files are retained.
en: Choose Retry to restart StandTerm and try again, or restore bundled Core. Existing files are kept.
context: Core unavailable dialog detail. Retry invokes restart(lastAction); displaying this dialog does not itself retry.
constraints: Keep response indices 0 Quit, 1 Retry, 2 Restore bundled Core, 3 Core source, 4 Open logs. defaultId=0/cancelId=0. Preserve fixed action IDs and lastAction replay; no automatic retry.

current_en: Browser authorization opened in the default browser.
en: Authorization link opened in the default browser.
context: Success notice after awaiting OS open callback; browser authorization has not been observed as completed.
constraints: Keep action open distinct from copy-auth/copy-url/copy-token; retain existing confirmation. Do not claim the browser is authorized or reveal the URL/token in the notice.

current_en: Access information copied. Treat it as a password.
en: Access information copied. Keep it private, like a password.
context: Shared notice for copied authorization URL, access URL, or access token; the copied payload is sensitive.
constraints: Keep exact clipboard payload and fixed action IDs; do not insert secrets into catalog parameters, logs or notifications. No extra mint, reveal, or retry.

current_en: Could not prepare browser access. Check that this Desktop backend is still running.
en: Could not prepare browser access. Check that this Desktop backend is running.
context: Sanitized generic failure notice; implementation deliberately discards URL-bearing network errors.
constraints: Preserve generic failure and error=true notification. Never display raw caught errors, URLs, grants or tokens. Keep pending/available guards and no automatic retry.

constraints: Keep Agent Info recognizable. Preserve optional installation, bundled-skill/helper guidance and the distinction between copying instructions and installing skills. Do not modify prompt contents or imply automatic installation.
